charts.title: GJ 357 b: orbits around GJ 357
charts.description: The orbits of GJ 357's planets in this map from above, to scale, with GJ 357 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Oddo et al. 2023 (2023AJ....165..134O), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ODDO_ET_AL__2023): P 3.9306 d

charts.title: GJ 357 b: its transit
charts.description: GJ 357 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (62, 89, 99) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 413248763, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 5-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 5-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
